items.title: How Well Do Models Follow Their Constitutions?
items.title_zh: 模型对其行为宪章的遵循程度如何？
items.summary: The authors present a multi-method audit that decomposes Anthropic's constitution into 205 testable tenets and OpenAI's Model Spec into 197, then probes seven models per specification with multi-turn adversarial scenarios. Violation rates fell from 15.0% for Claude Sonnet 4 to 2.0% for Sonnet 4.6 and from 11.7% for GPT-4o to 3.6% for GPT-5.2, though the authors cannot isolate whether the gains come from specification-specific training, broader post-training or evaluation awareness.

items.title: Paraphrase Brittleness in Production Retrieval-Augmented Commercial Recommendation: Reproducibility Below the Rerun-Stability Baseline
items.title_zh: 生产级检索增强商业推荐中的改写脆弱性：可复现性低于同提示重跑基线
items.summary: Across roughly 6,000 paraphrase runs and 6,000 same-prompt rerun controls on OpenAI and Anthropic models, recommendation-set similarity between two paraphrases of the same buying intent was 0.288 for cosmetic rewording and 0.135 for constraint-adding rewording, versus a 0.50-0.61 rerun baseline. The authors argue that tracking brand mentions over fixed prompts is structurally unstable as a measurement unit because the prompt string, not buyer intent, dominates which brands surface.

items.title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
items.title_zh: 通过自我调节的模拟式规划实现高效智能体推理
items.summary: CMU and MBZUAI researchers decompose agent reasoning into simulative planning, self-regulation and reactive execution to build SR²AM; the 30B version matches 685B-1T parameter systems while using 25.8-95.3% fewer reasoning tokens.

items.title: Benchmarking Patent Embeddings: A Multi-Task Evaluation of 22 Models Across Retrieval, Classification, and Clustering
items.title_zh: 专利嵌入基准：22 个模型在检索、分类与聚类上的多任务评估
items.summary: The study evaluates 22 pretrained embedding models from 22M to 12B parameters on retrieval, classification and clustering over 113,148 WIPO assistive-technology patents plus the external DAPFAM dataset. It finds that the best fine-tuning recipe depends on the downstream task, and that single-landscape fine-tuning degrades cross-domain retrieval for five of eight model-recipe combinations.

items.title: Beyond Final Answers: Auditing Trajectory-Level Hallucinations in Multi-Agent Industrial Workflows
items.title_zh: 超越最终答案：审计多智能体工业工作流中的轨迹级幻觉
items.summary: Trajel is a dataset and evaluation framework with a five-type hallucination taxonomy over expert-annotated agent traces from AssetOpsBench, covering factual, referential, logical, procedural and scope-based failures. The authors report that nearly half of hallucinated trajectories involve multiple types at once and that trajectory-aware detection significantly outperforms standard post-hoc verification.

items.title: Divergent Recommendations, Convergent Diagnoses: Cross-Provider Failure-Mode Convergence in AI Commercial Recommendation
items.title_zh: 推荐分歧、诊断趋同：AI 商业推荐中的跨提供商故障模式收敛
items.summary: Across 215 commercially framed prompts, ChatGPT and Claude disagreed on which brands they recommend roughly two-thirds of the time, with a cross-provider recommendation Jaccard of 0.35. On 7,763 joint failures the two providers diagnosed the same failure mode 95.1% of the time, with agreement rising to 99.6% for long-tail regional brands.

items.title: EPPC-OASIS: Ontology-Aware Adaptation and Structured Inference Refinement for Electronic Patient-Provider Communication Mining in Secure Messages
items.title_zh: EPPC-OASIS：面向安全消息中医患沟通挖掘的本体感知适配与结构化推理精炼
items.summary: EPPC-OASIS augments supervised fine-tuning with a Wasserstein alignment objective that aligns model representation neighborhoods with EPPC ontology-derived neighborhoods, plus inference refinement using verification, self-consistency, hybrid correction and ensembling. The best deployable pipeline reached 77.13% Code+Sub-code F1 and 63.83% Triplet F1, modest but consistent absolute gains over the strongest supervised baseline.

items.title: Full Attention Strikes Back: Transferring Full Attention into Sparse within Hundred Training Steps
items.title_zh: 全注意力反击：百步训练内将全注意力转为稀疏注意力
items.summary: RTPurbo exploits intrinsic sparsity in full-attention LLMs by keeping the full KV cache only for retrieval heads and adding a 16-dimensional token indexer; a few hundred training steps yield up to 9.36x prefill speedup at 1M context with near-lossless accuracy.

items.title: Bayesian Rational Search Engine User
items.title_zh: 贝叶斯理性的搜索引擎用户
items.summary: The paper models a user who decides whether to inspect another search result or stop, where each inspection both yields a candidate and updates beliefs about the remaining page. It shows the optimal policy is a depth-dependent standout rule, derives a closed-form distribution of inspection depth, and applies the resulting likelihood to public Baidu search logs.

items.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
items.title_zh: WorldKV：借助世界检索与压缩的高效世界记忆
items.summary: KAIST AI's WorldKV is a training-free framework that stores evicted KV-cache chunks and retrieves scene-relevant ones by camera or action correspondence, adding token pruning to match full-KV fidelity at roughly 2x throughput on video world models.

items.title: Rethinking Continual Anomaly Detection on the Edge: Benchmarking Under Realistic Industrial Conditions
items.title_zh: 重新思考边缘端持续异常检测：真实工业条件下的基准评测
items.summary: The paper introduces a unified continual anomaly detection benchmark with discrete-task evaluation, a continuous drift protocol, head-to-head comparison of published methods and edge efficiency profiling. It also proposes DINOSaur, a training-free method combining a frozen DINOv3 backbone with spatially indexed coreset memory that achieves zero forgetting by construction and sub-100 ms inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano.

items.title: Launch HN: Superset (YC P26) – IDE for the agents era
items.title_zh: Superset：面向智能体时代的 IDE
items.summary: Superset is an open-source agentic IDE from a YC P26 team for running coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode in parallel on isolated git worktrees; its Launch HN post drew 108 points and 135 comments.

items.title: How Virgin Atlantic ships faster with Codex
items.title_zh: 维珍航空如何借助 Codex 加速交付
items.summary: OpenAI describes how Virgin Atlantic used Codex to rebuild its mobile app against a fixed holiday travel deadline, reaching near-total unit test coverage and zero P1 defects.
